parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposures are documented and partly universal: consular cable tells officers to refuse visas where documents cast doubt on sex, with a possible lifetime fraud bar; eight-plus governments issued travel advisories over document/data rules; facility bans cover roughly 40% of states, criminalizing in 4, with a documented arrest and 24-hour men's-ward holding; federal custody imposes birth-sex placement and forced un-transition. Worst features sit at tiers 1-2 (state-imposed facility/custody rules, border refusal). Offsets: no criminalisation of trans identity, no documented killings, functioning courts granting some relief, most states unbanned, federal hate-crime law. No state campaign against trans visitors, but the national posture is hostile and the passport/visa policy survived review.
